databases.title: Public Domain Classics
databases.author: david morais
databases.readme:
# Public Domain Classics

A wrestling roster of 121 legendary characters from mythology, classic literature, history, and early cinema — all reimagined as wrestling superstars. Every character is in the public domain.

## Version

**1.2.0** — updated for game **0.9.5**. Adds gimmick types and free-text gimmicks, commentator call styles, contract clauses (indie appearances, non-compete, auto-renew), sponsorships, wrestling schools, a promotion alliance, a CCW brand split, and seeded storylines and tournaments.

## Contents

- **wrestlers.json**: 121 wrestlers and 30 staff split across two promotions
  - **Colosseum Championship Wrestling (CCW)**: 80 wrestlers, plus a crew of Olympians and ancient poets (Zeus, Athena, Homer, Themis, Chiron and others)
  - **Wonderland Pro Wrestling (WPW)**: 41 wrestlers, plus a crew from Victorian fiction (Phileas Fogg, Scheherazade, Dr. Watson, Inspector Lestrade and others)
- **promotions.json**: 2 themed promotions, each with weekly shows, four PPVs, five titles, and four tag teams or trios

## Image sources

**Portraits**: Hosted on Google Drive. Download the `people`, `logos`, and `belts` folders and point the game's datapack images folder at them.

- Image host: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Zbwi9Y_tJrE7-3ZPQxeejymLNsWvrT2H
- Images are not embedded in the `.bbdb`; `picture` and `logo` fields are filenames that resolve against the host.
- Art is original or public-domain illustration (no copyrighted film designs, no real logos).

## Gimmick themes

Characters are split by thematic promotion:

- **CCW (Colosseum Championship Wrestling)**: Gods, titans, legendary warriors, and historical conquerors
- **WPW (Wonderland Pro Wrestling)**: Gothic, surreal, and pulp storytelling — Dracula, Sherlock Holmes, the Wizard of Oz cast, and early cinema monsters

## Building on this pack

Refer to `BATTLEPLAN.md` and `prompts.md` for:
- Full roster list with card position and gimmick hooks
- Step-by-step build instructions
- Portrait generation prompts ready for AI art tools
- Legal cautions around trademark/copyright (important!)

databases.title: Real World by Shozukan
databases.author: Shozukan
databases.readme:
# Real World Datapack - November 2026

A real-world November 2026 snapshot for Booker Blitz.

![preview](preview.jpg)

15 promotions, 9,365 people, 1,200 signed contracts, 8,165 free agents. Built for playing the Monday night wars with real rosters, real staff, and real title / show structures.

[Images 🔻](https://www.mediafire.com/file/doqfrfek4rcpka4/RWNov26.zip/file)

## Stats

- **Promotions:** 15
- **Wrestlers / personnel:** 9,365
- **Free agents:** 8,165 (87% of pool)
- **Contracts:** 1,200
- **Active:** 1,200 (100% active)
- **Avg ability:** 47.5 (Median: 40)
- **In dev:** 75
- **Retired:** 810

## Contents

- **promotions.json** - 15 promotions, each with weekly shows, PPVs, titles, tag teams and signed staff
- **wrestlers.json** - 9,365 people: 7,769 wrestlers, 1,200 signed, 8,165 free agents
- **indies.json** - 10 indies
- **alliances.json** - 4 alliances

### Roster by promotion

| id | Promotion | Lvl | Signed workers |
|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | TNA | 4 | 72 |
| 2 | WWE | 9 | 176 |
| 3 | NXT | 4 | 104 |
| 5 | ROH | 4 | 50 |
| 21 | AAA | 6 | 53 |
| 22 | CMLL | 8 | 123 |
| 23 | AJPW | 6 | 36 |
| 24 | NJPW | 8 | 76 |

| 26 | Dragongate | 5 | 57 |
| 37 | DDT | 5 | 49 |
| 49 | Stardom | 4 | 41 |
| 58 | BJW | 4 | 61 |
| 338 | AEW | 6 | 185 |
| 353 | NWA | 4 | 71 |

### Staff ecosystem - 380 assigned keyStaff slots

Owner 12, GM 7, Booker 11, Writers 36, Interviewer 23, Ring Announcers 36, Commentators 77, Referees 85, Medic Team 20, Scouts 15, Road Agents 42, Trainers 16.

By personnel type (`wrestler.type`, 9,365 total):

Wrestler 7,769, Manager 165, Commentator 159, Interviewer 20, Ring Announcer 48, Referee 320, Writer 433, Businessperson 27, Medic 42, Scout 122, Trainer 268.

## Image sources

**The `.bbdb` embeds no images.** `picture`, `logo` and staff `pic` fields are filenames only (`CM Punk.png`, `WWE_alt1.png`). Download the `RWNov26` image pack from MediaFire (the only image host for this pack), extract it, and point DataStudio's datapack import at the extracted image folder.

- Image host: MediaFire `RWNov26.zip` (same pack as Real World November 2026)
- Images are not embedded in the `.bbdb`; `picture` and `logo` fields are filenames that resolve against the host.

Found a missing / wrong portrait or logo in the image pack? Report it on the reddit thread so it can get fixed in the next pack update.

## Real names

Wrestler, staff and promotion names are real and are used descriptively. No real promotion logo or trademarked artwork is included in this repository.

databases.author: Sonyahaus3n (community)
databases.readme:
# Real World November 2026

⚠️ This is built from TEW's IX Real World Chronicles 2026 (August Update)

A live-roster snapshot of sixteen real wrestling promotions as of November 2026, built for Booker Blitz.

Every person is real: full attribute sets, real finishers and gimmicks, real birthplaces and debut dates, and the title, tag-team, show and PPV structure each company actually runs.

Cross-promotion talent carries **non-exclusive** deals — AEW names who also work New Japan, CMLL and ROH regulars who double on the US indies, Stardom talent appearing in AEW, and so on. Their extra deals live in `additionalContracts` and resolve into real contracts when a game starts.

## Contents

- **promotions.json** — 16 promotions, each with its weekly shows, PPVs, titles, tag teams and signed staff
- **wrestlers.json** — 4,270 people: 981 signed wrestlers, 292 signed staff, and 2,997 free agents
- **alliances.json** — 6 alliances: WWE Universe, Forbidden Door, CyberFight, IndependentWrestling.TV, The Collective, United Japan Pro Wrestling

## Roster breakdown

| id | Promotion | Lvl | Base | Signed wrestlers | Signed staff |
|---:|---|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 3 | AJPW | 7 | Japan | 36 | 6 |
| 5 | AAA | 6 | Mexico | 48 | 10 |
| 11 | CMLL | 8 | Mexico | 157 | 29 |
| 28 | TNA | 6 | USA | 48 | 17 |
| 38 | NJPW | 9 | Japan | 56 | 24 |
| 44 | PROGRESS | 3 | UK | 22 | 2 |
| 45 | NOAH | 7 | Japan | 48 | 11 |
| 49 | ROH | 5 | USA | 78 | 7 |
| 61 | Stardom | 6 | Japan | 46 | 6 |
| 64 | WWE | 10 | USA | 104 | 65 |
| 65 | NXT | 6 | USA | 73 | 32 |
| 68 | MLW | 4 | USA | 30 | 8 |
| 76 | AEW | 9 | USA | 115 | 52 |
| 77 | GCW | 4 | USA | 49 | 7 |
| 79 | NWA | 5 | USA | 49 | 12 |
| 118 | MLP | 3 | USA | 22 | 4 |

Wages are monthly. Contracts are dated relative to the start date (`2026-01-01`); the game shifts them to whatever start date you pick at New Game.

## Downloads

For legal reasons this pack is not hosted in this repository. Both files are hosted on MediaFire:

- **Datapack (.bbdb):** https://www.mediafire.com/file/xhzd17anc36qtex/real-world-november-2026.bbdb/file
- **Image pack (RWNov26.zip):** https://www.mediafire.com/file/doqfrfek4rcpka4/RWNov26.zip/file

## Image sources

**The `.bbdb` embeds no images.** `picture`, `logo` and staff `pic` fields are filenames only (`Mistico.png`, `AEW_alt2.png`). Download `RWNov26.zip` from MediaFire (the only image host for this pack), extract it, and point DataStudio's datapack import at the extracted image folder.

## Real names

Wrestler, staff and promotion names are real and are used descriptively. No real promotion logo or trademarked artwork is included in this repository.
